messages:
Marco: Quick update — today is my 5 year anniversary at Redwood! Also adopted a tiny pup this weekend named Mochi 🐶. Feeling nostalgic and excited :tada:
Jenna: OMG congrats!!! 5 years is huge. Mochi pics pls :heart_eyes:
Alex: Huge congrats Marco!! Couldn't have asked for a better infra partner. Also puppy pics are non-negotiable :dog:
Priya: 5 YEARS?! time flies. Congrats — coffee on me tomorrow? I'll bring something from the bakery :croissant:
Marco: Love that — 11am in the kitchen area works? Here’s one photo: https://imgur.com/placeholder-mochi (Mochi likes naps and ethernet cables)
Sam: Awwwwww so wholesome :smile: congrats on the milestone and the pup. Also shoutout for all the late-night deploy help over the years 🙏
Olive: Congrats Marco!! Can we do a quick 30s shoutout in Friday all-hands? people-ops: any objections?
people-ops: We love this! We'll add a 30s shoutout for Marco in Friday's all-hands and send a digital card. Also sending the anniversary swag box next week :tada:
Alex: tagging people-ops for the swag — also we should get Mochi a little Redwood bandana? :smile:
Priya: added a note to the card link — https://redwood.cards/abc. Also I 2nd the bandana idea :party_parrot:
Marco: You all are the best — thank you. Really grateful to be here and for the team. Mochi says hi and will be in the office for quick cuddles (only if approved by facilities of course) :dog:
Sam: Approved in spirit. Facilities sign-off pending but I will bribe them with cookies :cookie:
Jenna: Will need at least 8 dog pics to be considered legitimate celebration docs.
Olive: Added to calendar: quick coffee for Marco on Thursday 11am. All welcome!
people-ops: Note: if anyone wants to send physical treats to Marco's desk, please coordinate with us for allergy-safe options.
Marco: Thanks again everyone — see you Thursday! Mochi will bring the tail wags.
